title: Father’s Heart Bible — Women's Bible
sub: For Young Women, Single Women, Married Women, Widows, Working Women, Women in Ministry, and Women Walking Through Infertility

hook.h2: You have been many things to many people. To your Father, you are first His daughter
hook.text: He told her, “Daughter, your faith made you well. Go in peace, healed of your suffering.”
son: “Daughter, your faith made you well. Go in peace, healed of your suffering.”
hook.note: She had spent everything she had on twelve years of doctors and only grew worse. She reached through a crowd to touch the edge of His cloak, hoping no one would notice. Jesus stopped everything to find her, and the first word He spoke to her was a name. He does not see a face in the crowd. He sees His daughter, and He rejoices over you.

short350: Young women and widows, single and married, women at work and women in ministry, women starting over and women who mentor others: the Women's Bible from Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) is the Holy Bible made for you.

Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color™ is a complete Bible, Old and New Testaments, in a fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek that reveals God as your Father. It is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's words in RED, the Spirit's words in PURPLE.
It equips you to receive the Father, hear His voice, and know His heart is for you.

For young women and college women, single and married women, wives and widows, working women and women in ministry, women walking through infertility, breast cancer survivors, military wives, caregivers and mentors. For every role she carries: daughter, sister, friend, bride, wife, mother, aunt, grandmother, mentor and leader.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page.

A woman is named by many voices — daughter, wife, mother, friend, colleague, the one everyone calls. Our Father names her first, and He does it in His own words: "Do not be afraid, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine." (Isaiah 43:1) He is not waiting for you to become someone else before He speaks. This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, for a quiet morning alone or a table of women opening it together.
An interpretive translation with a stated theological emphasis: the revelation of God as Father. Not a paraphrase — every word is rendered from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: He Has Been Speaking The Whole Time
body: For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

long.h: Before Anyone Else Named You, Your Father Called You By Name.
body: A woman is named by many voices — daughter, wife, mother, friend, colleague, the one everyone calls. Our Father names her first, and He does it in His own words: "Do not be afraid, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine." (Isaiah 43:1)

He is not waiting for you to become someone else before He speaks. This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, for a quiet morning alone or a table of women opening it together.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal. This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: Abba Father, your Heavenly Father, and you, His beloved daughter. If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

features: A single volume complete Bible — 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses
An introduction to each book, and a Father's note closing every book with a short prayer
1,355 study notes, including 31 on manuscript differences
A presentation page — a gift, and a keepsake worth handing on
Paperback and hardcover, 6 x 9, full color throughout: a gift, a keepsake, an heirloom

faq.q: What makes the Women's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — with a cover and opening pages made for a woman. Those pages include a dedication, Where to Turn, and a presentation page for their name. Everything from Genesis 1:1 onward is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is the Women's Bible a complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,085 verses, 890 pages, full color throughout. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note and short prayer closes each one, and 1,355 study notes run through the whole Bible.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for women?
faq.a: It is made for it. A 6 x 9 Bible in hardcover or paperback with a presentation page for their name, in a cover made for women rather than a generic pew edition.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
